Summary: The retrieval performance in the full wiki setting for HotpotQA Yang 2018 is Hits@10 55.88, as shown in Table 5 of the paper. The performance in the full wiki setting is substantially lower, posing a challenge to existing techniques on retrieval-based question answering. Overall, model performance in all settings is significantly lower than human performance, indicating that more technical advancements are needed in future work.
